comparison.objective: Tune and lock dynamic shock absorption versus select a driver bit and tighten drawer hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require recessed-tool engagement and controlled tightening; candidate additionally adjusts a collar and evaluates repeated impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two energy-qualified stops without bottoming or drift; record requires screw feed, knob closure, hold test, and tool return.
comparison.reason: Shared fastening primitives do not test the same ability. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift tolerances are not yet numerically declared, but that omission does not create plausible duplication.
